world.title: ‘We have 13 weeks’: A ruptured Democratic Party now tries to unite behind Abdul El-Sayed
world.description: Abdul El-Sayed’s plan as he left his last polling place stop on Tuesday afternoon was to take the stage at the Majestic Theater on Woodward Avenue as early as 10 p.m. to deliver a speech he knew had to be more about reaching out. world.title: Emergent BioSolutions Commits to Cross-Sector Collaboration Against Biological Threats in an Evolving Global Security Environment
world.description: GAITHERSBURG, Md., Aug. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Emergent BioSolutions (NYSE:EBS), a global biodefense company, today highlighted the increasing importance of biological threat preparedness as allied nations confront an evolving security environment characterized by geopolitical conflict, artificial intelligence (AI) and synthetic biology and growing concern about the potential misuse of biological agents. Defense and public health leaders are addressing the heightened risks of biological incidents, whether naturally occurring outbreaks, accidental releases or deliberate acts, which represent a critical component of national resilience and security planning.

world.title: 'Spooky' particles transit DC suburbs, a step toward a quantum network
world.description: In early 2025, special signals wended their way through a fiber-optic highway strung above the streets and sidewalks of the Maryland suburbs. The arrival of those signals at their destination marks a significant step toward a long-held dream of building a "quantum network." Researchers believe that this emerging technology could someday link quantum devices in ways that supercharge scientific research, enable ultrasecure communications and boost the power of future quantum computers.
